name: Hyouryuu Buttai X
source:
The United Nations Space Army landing craft Matanicov is on a mission commissioned by the Earth's Interstellar Transport Office, and picks up a mysterious body from a warship drifting in the middle of outer space.

Will they safely manage to make their way back to the Mars base...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ040538.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
联合国太空军登陆艇马塔尼科夫号受地球星际运输办公室委托执行任务，从一艘漂流在外太空中部的战舰上捡起一具神秘尸体。

他们能否安全返回火星基地……？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ040538.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
